symptom: Round 4 package omitted model context injection despite current source containing it
direct_cause: Both dist scripts package existing outputs without validating their source identity
class_root: Packaging must enforce matching HEAD and working tree identity for both build outputs
affected_population: Both packaging scripts, all branches and dirty worktrees
internal_only_reason: This is an internal Git/build assembly invariant; no SDK or external format changes.
invariants: Both output stamps must match the current HEAD and actual working tree hash before packaging
generality_proof: Both package scripts call verifyBuild, full builds stamp only after success and stable inputs, partial builds invalidate both stamps.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject missing or mismatched identities before packaging

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Runs shared stamp verification before electron-builder
Runs shared stamp verification before electron-builder

recurrence.reason: Every packaging invocation can reuse old output after a source change
same_class_scan: rg electron-builder scripts package.json: both dist entry points directly package existing output
Inspected build:renderer and build:electron: partial compilation can mix outputs

prevention.invariant: Current source identity must equal both successful full-build stamps
prevention.failure_mode: Exit nonzero with pnpm build instruction; failed builds leave no valid stamps
prevention.strategy: Invalidate before every build; stamp after successful stable full build; verify at both package entry points

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaced unchecked packaging scripts; no alternate package script retained

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No external dependency behavior controls the missing internal assembly invariant

migration: Existing unstamped builds must be rebuilt with pnpm build; never infer or backfill identity.
residual_risks: Stamps prove source identity, not artifact tamper resistance; direct invocation of electron-builder outside package scripts is outside this boundary.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Build and packaging assembly owns artifact/source identity
